title: Concept: File response built from a runtime path in python — review required
description: In python, a file response is produced from a runtime path. The framework will serve whatever path it receives, including absolute paths and parent traversal, unless the application normalises it. Download endpoints are a common place for request parameters to reach this call unchanged.
applicability: python web services that return files.
risk: Disclosure of files outside the intended directory; MEDIUM severity.
